changelog:
Choose settings-area navigation directly in Appearance: top tabs, bottom tabs, adaptive sidebar or compact area selector.
Navigation style applies immediately and is saved. Narrow screens adapt the sidebar without losing your choice.
Preserved direct areas, shared controls, full settings search, readable values and prerequisite/safety summaries.
Improved TV D-pad handoffs for bottom tabs and sidebar, including offscreen areas and correct focus after switching.
message: Dev build v850 - Configurable settings navigation
